insights.summary: Finance and procurement push back on paying separately for add-ons (PreSense, QM seats, AI Voice Agent minutes) at renewal.
insights.quote: Finance and procurement, they push back on paying separately for every little thing. You know, PreSense, QM seats, AI Voice Agent minutes.

insights.summary: Customer links "add-on pricing friction at renewal" to the renewal decision.
insights.quote: It's the add-on pricing friction at renewal. That's what I keep hearing.
I'm looking at all our vendor spend, and my boss, the regional VP, is asking me point blank whether we should renew with Invoca or take a hard look at Marchex.
